params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Yuumi's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}}}} and become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Upon hitting them with the basic attack or ''{{ai|Prowling Projectile|Yuumi}}'', or upon a ''{{ai|Final Chapter|Yuumi}}'' hit on ally champions while ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'', the buff is consumed to {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|20 + (110-20)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}. If she is ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally or does so within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally, '''Yuumi''' grants them 2 <!--PFT:Increased to 3 on champion kills?--> permanent ''Friendship'' stacks whenever they kill enemy champions or minions. The ally with the highest ''Friendship'' stacks becomes '''Yuumi's''' ''Best Friend'', which empowers her abilities with additional effects while she is ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to them.
params.notes:
* ''Feline Friendship'' will not be consumed if '''Yuumi''' isn't missing health, except when triggered by a basic attack. While {{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}, it won't be consumed if both '''Yuumi''' and her anchor aren't missing health.
* Enemy hits with ''{{ai|Final Chapter|Yuumi}}'' won't trigger ''Feline Friendship''.{{bug|2}}
* Ability hit against enemy champions while detached can only heal '''Yuumi'''.{{bug|2}}
* ''Feline Friendship'' will apply to a basic attack already in flight.
* If there are multiple allies who have equal ''Friendship'' stacks, the one '''Yuumi''' is currently attached to becomes her ''Best Friend''.
* {{Pending for test}} Empowered attack interaction with parrying effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}).
** If '''Yuumi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, ''Feline Friendship'' won't be consumed.
* {{pending for test}} does '''Yuumi''' generate more friendship stacks from champion kills?
<!-- Blurb -->

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While ''{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|attached}}'' to an ally, '''Yuumi''' grants them permanent ''Friendship'' stacks for killing enemy champions and minions. params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yuumi}} fires an errant missile in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and briefly {{tip|slow|slows}} the target if they were a champion.
params.blurb4:
{{sbc|{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|Attached}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} briefly to steer the missile, after which it accelerates to deal increased damage and apply a stronger slow to champions.
{{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} Always applies the stronger {{tip|slow}} and grants her ''Best Friend'' bonus on-hit damage for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' fires an errant missile in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit. If the target is a champion, they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 20% for 1 second.
params.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|You and Me!|Yuumi|Attached}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for up to {{fd|1.35}} seconds to steer the missile at a slower speed. After being in flight for the same duration, the missile accelerates in its current direction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds to deal increased damage and apply a stronger slow against champions that decays to 20% over 2 seconds.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} ''Prowling Projectile'' always applies its enhanced slow against champions and hitting a champion grants her ''Best Friend'' {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for 5 seconds, increased by {{pp|0 to 75 for 11|0 to 100|key=%|key1=%|type=''Anchor's'' critical strike chance|color=critical strike chance}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} While {{ci|Yuumi}} is {{tip|attached}}, she is {{tip|untargetable}} and casts her abilities from the ''Anchor's'' position, empowering them with additional effects.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion to {{tip|attach}} to them. ''You and Me!'' can be recast while attached.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Yuumi''' detaches from her ''Anchor'' and {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion to {{tip|attach}} to them. If this is cast without a target, she will {{tip|dash}} out to detach.
params.blurb4:
''You and Me!'' is placed on a short {{sti|cooldown}} if '''Yuumi''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
{{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' gains {{as|{{sti|heal and shield power}}}} and her ''Best Friend'' gains {{tip|on-hit}} {{tip|healing}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Yuumi''' is {{tip|attached}}, she is {{tip|untargetable}} (except by {{tip|turrets}} and inbound {{tip|projectile|projectiles}}) and casts her abilities from the ''Anchor's'' position, empowering them with additional effects.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, then upon completion {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion and {{tip|Attached|attaches}} to them upon arrival, designating them as her ''Anchor''. ''You and Me!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the attachment.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Change of Plan:}} '''Yuumi''' detaches from her ''Anchor'' and {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion to {{tip|attach}} to them, refreshing the recast. She will detach automatically if her ''Anchor'' dies or under {{tt|certain circumstances|See notes}}. If recast without a valid target, '''Yuumi''' will detach and {{tip|dash}} 250-units in the target direction, placing ''You and Me!'' on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.25}}}}-second cooldown if it is not already on cooldown.
params.description4: '''''Yuumi''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash to the ally.''
params.description5: '''Yuumi''' starts with a skill point in ''You and Me!'' and ''{{ai|Prowling Projectile|Yuumi}}'' instead has 6 ranks.
params.description6:
{{sbc|{{ai|Feline Friendship|Yuumi|Best Friend}} Bonus:}} '''Yuumi''' gains {{as|{{sti|heal and shield power}}}} and her ''Best Friend'' gains {{tip|heal|healing}} {{tip|on-hit}}.


''You and Me!'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if '''Yuumi''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.

params.notes:
* The ''Best Friend's'' healing on-hit is affected by '''Yuumi's''' heal and shield power.
* '''Yuumi''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
* If the target moves {{tt|2000|Estimated}} or more units away from '''Yuumi''' during the dash, it will be interrupted and ''You and Me!'' will be placed on full cooldown.
* The {{fd|0.5}}-second cooldown will be incurred whenever '''Yuumi''' attaches to an ''Anchor'', whether by the active or the recast.
* Attempting to recast ''You and Me!'' on an ally that is out of range will briefly glow a range indicator of the ability and indicate that the target is ''"Out of Range!"''.
* ''You and Me!'' does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''You and Me!'' does not count as a buff for {{ri|Summon Aery}}.
* The initial cast and recast of ''You and Me!'' have a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
** This behavior can override her direction-targeted {{tip|dash}} to discard any target.
* '''Yuumi''' can channel the {{ii|Eye of the Herald}} while attached.
* '''Yuumi''' will automatically detach in the following circumstances:
** When her ''Anchor'' starts a {{si|Teleport}} channel.
** After the ''Anchor'' completes a {{si|Recall}} channel.
** Her ''Anchor'' is sent to the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}}.
** She is pulled by {{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}}.
** When she or her ''Anchor'' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
*** If '''Yuumi''' is channeling ''You and Me!'' or already dashing towards an ally who enters {{tip|resurrection}}, then she will successfully attach to the resurrecting ally, and she will be able to heal/shield them during it.
* '''Yuumi''' doesn't ''detach'' instantly when her ''Anchor'' dies. There's a small grace period in which she can recast ''You and Me!'' to attach to another champion without the {{tip|channel}} or dash in the target direction.
* '''Yuumi''' can dash to targetable {{tip|zombie state}} allies (currently only {{cai|Glory in Death|Sion}}), but she cannot attach when she reaches them.
** The same goes for allies channeling {{si|Teleport}}.
* While attached to the ''Anchor'', '''Yuumi''' is considered in being at her ''Anchor's'' position, regardless of where she is visually placed near them. For example, {{tip|turret}} shots will appear as if they were hitting the ''Anchor'', but in reality they're actually hitting '''Yuumi'''.
** However, for the purposes of ''You and Me!'', such as casting it or being unattached for other reasons, '''Yuumi''' will be in the position where she visually is. For example, when she is in the blue team, dashing to a north-east ally is considerably slower than dashing to a south-west ally.
* Her {{tip|monster}} aggression transfers to the ''Anchor''.
* Enemies are credited an [[assist]] on '''Yuumi''' if they damaged the ''Anchor'' at any point and she dies within the standard credit timer.
* '''Yuumi''' will '''always''' be {{tip|sight|visible}} if her ''Anchor'' can be seen, and she will '''always''' not be visible if her ''Anchor'' cannot be seen. These rules apply regardless of {{tip|sight|reveal}} effects and {{tip|stealth}}.
* '''Yuumi''' will not {{tip|vanish}} if her ''Anchor'' does.
* If '''Yuumi''' is on the blue team, she will remain attached on the southwest side; if '''Yuumi''' is on the red team, she will remain on the northeast. While channeling {{ai|Final Chapter|Yuumi}}, she will be behind her ''Anchor''.
* The [[Summoner|player's]] screen will briefly flash red if '''Yuumi''' is affected by a {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|ground|grounding}} effect, or if she forcibly detaches from her ''Anchor''.
* {{tip|Sleep}} does not count for knocking the dash down.{{bug}}
* The ''Anchor's'' [[health bar]] will have a different frame to indicate the ''attached'' status:
[[File: Yuumi Health Bar.png|200px|center]]

** {{ri|Summon Aery}} and {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} would not trigger from the heal or shield when buffered.{{bug}}
